records.jp: どこだ、ここは……？
records.en_original: Where...are we?
records.en: Where...are we?

records.jp: 私たち、さっきまで戦ってたはずじゃ……
records.en_original: Weren't we just fighting a second ago?
records.en: Weren't we just fighting a second ago?

records.jp: リーダーさん……リーダーさんは？
records.en_original: Leader... Where is the leader?
records.en: Leader-san... Where is Leader-san?

records.jp: よかった、そこにいたんですね
records.en_original: Oh good, you were here all along.
records.en: Oh good, you were here all along.

records.jp: ねえ、ここどこ？<CR>なんかいつの間にか変な場所に飛ばされてたんだけど
records.en_original: Hey, where are we? I feel like we suddenly got tossed into some weird place.
records.en: Hey, where are we?<CR>I feel like we suddenly got tossed into some weird place.

records.jp: ついに黄泉の国まで来てしまったか……
records.en_original: Have we finally come all the way to the land of the dead?
records.en: Have we finally come all the way to the land of the dead?

records.jp: ここはこの世でも、あの世でもない場所
records.en_original: This is a place that's neither the world of the living nor the world of the dead.
records.en: This is a place that's neither the world of the living nor the world of the dead.

records.jp: 雫世界とコモンを繋ぐ中間地点、みたいな感じかな
records.en_original: It's like a midpoint connecting the Oasis and the Common.
records.en: It's like a midpoint connecting the Oasis and the Common.

records.jp: もっともここが消滅したら、<CR>みんなの魂も消滅しちゃうんだけど
records.en_original: If this place disappears, everyone's souls will vanish as well.
records.en: If this place disappears,<CR>everyone's souls will vanish as well.

records.jp: これからあなたたちの記憶は初期化される
records.en_original: Now, your memories are about to be reset.
records.en: Now, your memories are about to be reset.

records.jp: 次に目覚めた時に、この世界の記憶はもう残っていない
records.en_original: When you wake up next, all memories of this world will be gone.
records.en: When you wake up next, all memories of this world will be gone.

records.jp: 同じ場所にいられるかもわからない
records.en_original: There's no telling if you'll even be in the same place.
records.en: There's no telling if you'll even be in the same place.

records.jp: なぜなら、あなたたちは今<CR>雫世界の根幹を担っている状態
records.en_original: Because right now, you all are carrying the very core of the Oasis.
records.en: Because right now,<CR>you all are carrying the very core of the Oasis.

records.jp: 雫世界の行く末を、可能性を、<CR>様々な形で担っている状態だから
records.en_original: You're supporting the future of the Oasis—its possibilities—in all kinds of ways.
records.en: You're supporting the future of the Oasis—its<CR>possibilities—in all kinds of ways.

records.jp: 最後の挨拶をするなら、今しかないということか……
records.en_original: So, if we want to say our final goodbyes, this is our only chance...
records.en: So, if we want to say our final goodbyes, this is our only chance...

records.jp: せっかくこうしてまた集まれたのに、<CR>お別れになっちゃうかもしれないんですね……
records.en_original: Even though we just managed to come together like this again, I guess we might have to say goodbye...
records.en: Even though we just managed to come together<CR>like this again, I guess we might have to say goodbye...

records.jp: なーな
records.en_original: Nana...
records.en: Nana...

records.jp: きららはまた会えるって信じているぞ
records.en_original: I believe that we'll meet again!
records.en: Kirara believes we'll meet again!

records.jp: とっておきのまじないをかけたからな
records.en_original: I cast my super-secret spell to make sure of it.
records.en: I cast my super-secret spell to make sure of it.

records.jp: きらら……
records.en_original: Kirara...
records.en: Kirara...

records.jp: いや、信じているではなく会いに行く。<CR>どんなに時間がかかっても
records.en_original: Actually, no, I won't just believe, because I'll come see you. No matter how long it takes.
records.en: Actually, no. I won't just believe it—I'll come see you.<CR>No matter how long it takes.

records.jp: だったらわたしは、きららがすぐに見つけられるように<CR>超売れっ子になってあげる
records.en_original: Then I'll become super famous so it'll be easy for you to find me!
records.en: Then I'll become super famous so it'll be easy<CR>for you to find me!

records.jp: うむ、頑張ってくれたまえ
records.en_original: Very well, do your best!
records.en: Very well, do your best!

records.jp: そうですよね。<CR>また会える可能性だってあるわけですもんね
records.en_original: Yeah, that's right. There's always a chance we'll meet again, isn't there?
records.en: Yeah, that's right.<CR>There's always a chance we'll meet again, isn't there?

records.jp: も、森崎さん……？
records.en_original: Alesia?
records.en: Morisaki-san?

records.jp: あら～
records.en_original: Oh my...
records.en: Oh my...

records.jp: え！？　そういう関係だったの！？<CR>前回聞いてなかったんだけど！
records.en_original: What?! You two were like that?! Nobody told me last time!
records.en: What?! You two were like that?!<CR>Nobody told me last time!

records.jp: 生で初めて見た……
records.en_original: I've never seen it in person before...
records.en: I've never seen it in person before...

records.jp: そんなの大概そうでしょ
records.en_original: That's normal, isn't it?
records.en: That's normal, isn't it?

records.jp: 詩帆と出会ってから、私の世界は変わった
records.en_original: Ever since I met you, my whole world changed.
records.en: Ever since I met you, my whole world changed.

records.jp: 死を受け入れるだけじゃなくて、<CR>死に抗おうと思えた
records.en_original: It wasn't just about accepting death anymore. You made me want to fight against it.
records.en: It wasn't just about accepting death anymore.<CR>You made me want to fight against it.

records.jp: もう少しだけ、貴方の隣で生きていたいと<CR>思うようになった
records.en_original: Little by little, I found myself wanting to stay by your side, even just a bit longer.
records.en: Little by little, I found myself wanting to stay by your side,<CR>even just a bit longer.

records.jp: 詩帆が好き。これからもずっと
records.en_original: I love you, Shiho. Now and forever.
records.en: I love you, Shiho. Now and forever.

records.jp: 森崎さん……
records.en_original: Alesia...
records.en: Morisaki-san...

records.jp: どうしたの？　詩帆
records.en_original: What's wrong, Shiho?
records.en: What's wrong, Shiho?

records.jp: その、おっ、お返しを……
records.en_original: U-um, I... I wanted to return the favor—
records.en: U-um, I... I wanted to return the favor—

records.jp: すみません、やっぱりまだ無理です！！
records.en_original: S-sorry, I can't do it yet!
records.en: S-sorry, I can't do it yet!

records.jp: “まだ”ね
records.en_original: "Yet," huh?
records.en: "Yet," huh?

records.en_original: Ah...
records.en: Ah...

records.jp: いいのよ、無理しなくて。<CR>私がしたくて、しただけ
records.en_original: It's okay, you don't have to force yourself. I just did it because I wanted to.
records.en: It's okay, you don't have to force yourself.<CR>I just did it because I wanted to.

records.jp: 貴方はそれ以上のものを、私にいっぱいくれたから
records.en_original: You've already given me so much more than that.
records.en: You've already given me so much more than that.

records.jp: 森崎さん……
records.en_original: Alesia...
records.en: Morisaki-san...

records.jp: メイ、どうする？<CR>うちらもする？
records.en_original: Mei, what do you think? Should we try it too?
records.en: Mei, what do you think?<CR>Should we try it too?

records.jp: なっ……
records.en_original: What?!
records.en: What?!

records.jp: うそうそ、冗談
records.en_original: Just kidding, just kidding! It's a joke.
records.en: Just kidding, just kidding! It's a joke.

records.jp: 私たちに似合うのは、もっとこう……<CR>さっぱりした感じの……
records.en_original: What suits us more is, you know...something more laid back. More...chill?
records.en: What suits us more is, you know...something more laid back.<CR>More...chill?

records.jp: ……ずっと、ふがいない相棒で申し訳なかった
records.en_original: Sorry I've always been such a useless partner.
records.en: Sorry I've always been such a useless partner.

records.jp: 隊長だの、ベテランだの、色々言われたが……
records.en_original: People called me captain or veteran or whatever, but...
records.en: People called me captain or veteran or whatever, but...

records.jp: お前がずっと支えてくれたから、<CR>私はここまで踏ん張れたんだ
records.en_original: It's only because you were always there supporting me that I made it this far.
records.en: It's only because you were always there<CR>supporting me that I made it this far.

records.jp: そっくりそのままお返しするよ
records.en_original: Right back at you.
records.en: Right back at you.

records.jp: 私もメイがいてくれたから、ここまでやってこれた。<CR>ずっと強くなれた
records.en_original: I only got this strong because you were with me, Mei.
records.en: I only got this strong because you were with me,<CR>Mei.

records.jp: 格好つけないで、もうちょっと友達っぽいこと<CR>しとけばよかったかなって思うけど
records.en_original: Maybe I shouldn't have tried to act so cool... I wish I had acted more like a real friend.
records.en: Maybe I shouldn't have tried to act so cool...<CR>I wish I had acted more like a real friend.

records.jp: それは、私も耳が痛いな
records.en_original: Yeah, I feel that too. It's kind of hard to hear.
records.en: Yeah, I feel that too. It's kind of hard to hear.

records.jp: でも、そういうところが好きだよ
records.en_original: But, that's actually something I really like about you.
records.en: But, that's actually something I really like about you.

records.jp: ありがとね、メイ
records.en_original: Thanks, Mei.
records.en: Thanks, Mei.

records.jp: ふふっ
records.en_original: Hehe.
records.en: Hehe.

records.jp: な、なんで笑うの
records.en_original: Wh-why are you laughing?
records.en: Wh-why are you laughing?

records.jp: すっごく真面目な顔でこっち見てくるから～
records.en_original: Because you're looking at me with such a serious face.
records.en: Because you're looking at me with such a serious face.

records.jp: だって、それは……
records.en_original: Well, you know, that's because...
records.en: Well, you know, that's because...

records.jp: 結局こうして、みんな揃って次の世界に<CR>繋げられたんだから結果オーライだよ～
records.en_original: In the end, things turned out okay since we all ended up here together, ready to connect to the next world.
records.en: In the end, things turned out okay since we all ended up here together,<CR>ready to connect to the next world.

records.jp: まぁ、かんなとしては、元の世界を取り戻せなかった<CR>から心残りがあるかもしれないけど
records.en_original: Well, maybe there's still some regret for you since you didn't get your original world back.
records.en: Well, maybe there's still some regret for you since you<CR>didn't get your original world back.

records.jp: ……でも、かんなの苦しみが少しでも和らいで<CR>くれたらいいな
records.en_original: But I hope your suffering has eased, even if just a little.
records.en: But I hope your suffering has eased, even<CR>if just a little.

records.jp: え？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: 元の世界の私たちじゃなかったとしても、<CR>何度も何度も死ぬのを見るのは、辛かったでしょ？
records.en_original: Even if we're not the exact same as our original selves, it must've been painful to watch us die over and over again, right?
records.en: Even if we're not the exact same as our original selves,<CR>it must've been painful to watch us die over and over again, right?

records.jp: そんなこと……もう、慣れるほど見たから……
records.en_original: It's... I've seen it so many times that I've almost gotten used to it...
records.en: It's... I've seen it so many times that I've almost gotten used to it...

records.jp: そんなことない
records.en_original: That's not true.
records.en: That's not true.

records.jp: かんなは大切な人の死に慣れて、<CR>平気でいられるような子じゃない
records.en_original: You're not the kind of girl who can just get used to losing the people you love and act like it's nothing.
records.en: You're not the kind of girl who can just get used to losing<CR>the people you love and act like it's nothing.

records.jp: でしょ？
records.en_original: Am I wrong?
records.en: Am I wrong?

records.jp: ふふっ……ほんと、敵わないなぁ。<CR>彩未はどこの世界でも、やっぱり彩未だね
records.en_original: Hehe, honestly, I'm hopeless when it comes to you. Ayami really is Ayami, no matter the world.
records.en: Hehe, honestly, I'm hopeless when it comes to you.<CR>Ayami really is Ayami, no matter the world.

records.jp: ……ねえ、かんな。<CR>一つお願い
records.en_original: Hey, Kanna. Can I ask you for one thing?
records.en: Hey, Kanna. Can I ask you<CR>for one thing?

records.jp: ここから離れる前に、またいつものかんなが見たいな
records.en_original: Before we leave this place, I want to see the usual Kanna again.
records.en: Before we leave this place, I want to see the usual Kanna again.

records.jp: でも、今さら……
records.en_original: But after all that—
records.en: But after all that—

records.jp: 大丈夫
records.en_original: It's okay.
records.en: It's okay.

records.jp: どんな子でも、お姉さんの包容力で<CR>とろとろに甘やかしてあげちゃうから♪
records.en_original: No matter what kind of girl you are, I'll spoil you silly with all my big sister love.
records.en: No matter what kind of girl you are,<CR>I'll spoil you rotten with an older sister's loving care♪

records.jp: ……ふふっ
records.en_original: Hehe.
records.en: Hehe.

records.jp: それなんか逆に怖いよぉ……あやみん
records.en_original: You're actually kind of scaring me now, Ayamin...
records.en: You're actually kind of scaring me now, Ayamin...

records.jp: リーダー……さん……
records.en_original: Leader...
records.en: Leader...san...

records.jp: リーダーくんは今、雫世界の礎となるために、<CR>そして、みんなを守るための準備をしてくれてる
records.en_original: Leader is preparing right now, to become the foundation for the Oasis—and to protect all of us.
records.en: Leader-kun is preparing now to become the foundation of the Oasis<CR>and to protect everyone.

records.jp: きっと、最後にみんなの顔を見に来てくれたんだね
records.en_original: I bet he came to see everyone's faces one last time.
records.en: I bet he came to see everyone's faces one last time.

records.jp: リーダーさん……
records.en_original: Leader...
records.en: Leader-san...

records.jp: そろそろ、本当に最後の時間
records.en_original: It's almost time for the very end.
records.en: It's almost time for the very end.

records.jp: みんな、想いを捧げて
records.en_original: Everyone, send your feelings.
records.en: Everyone, send your feelings.

records.jp: 私たちの想いを使って世界を創るってことはさ
records.en_original: So, if we use our feelings to shape the world...
records.en: So, if we use our feelings to shape the world...

records.jp: 願えばある程度私たちの思い通りにできるってこと？
records.en_original: Does that mean, if we wish for it, we can make things just the way we want?
records.en: Does that mean, if we wish for it, we can make things just the way we want?

records.jp: そうとも言えるかもしれない
records.en_original: You could say that.
records.en: You could say that.

records.jp: 不平等のない世界がいい
records.en_original: I want a world without inequality.
records.en: I want a world without inequality.

records.jp: ブレないなぁ……
records.en_original: You never change, do you?
records.en: You never change, do you?

records.jp: じゃあ、私はずーっと読書し放題の世界がいいな。<CR>今まで読んだお気に入りの本が全部揃ってて……
records.en_original: Then I want a world where I can read as much as I want! With all my favorite books I've ever read lined up for me...
records.en: Then I want a world where I can read as much as I want!<CR>With all my favorite books I've ever read lined up for me...

records.jp: だったらお姉さんは毎日気軽に友達と会えて、一緒に<CR>いっぱい遊んだり、ご飯が食べられる世界がいいな～
records.en_original: If that's the case, I want a world where I can hang out with my friends every day, and play and eat together as much as we want.
records.en: If that's the case, I want a world where I can hang out with my<CR>friends every day, and play and eat together as much as we want.

records.jp: きららは、毎日夏休みの如く<CR>のんびり暮らしたい
records.en_original: I want to relax every day, like it's always summer vacation.
records.en: Kirara wants to live leisurely every day,<CR>as if every day were summer vacation.

records.jp: それだけだと怠けそうだな……<CR>私は高め合える仲間もいる世界であってほしい
records.en_original: If that's all, I might get a little too lazy... I want a world with friends who inspire me to be my best self.
records.en: If that's all, I might get a little too lazy...<CR>I want a world with friends who inspire me to be my best self.

records.jp: わたしは男のいない世界……うそ。<CR>男女関係なく、居心地良い奴ばっかりの世界
records.en_original: I want a world without boys in it... Just kidding. I want a world where everyone, no matter their gender, is easy to be around.
records.en: I want a world without boys in it... Just kidding.<CR>I want a world where everyone, no matter their gender, is easy to be around.

records.jp: ……素をさらけ出しても、<CR>受け入れてくれる人のいる世界
records.en_original: I want a world where you can show your true self, and people will still accept you.
records.en: I want a world where you can show your true self,<CR>and people will still accept you.

records.jp: たとえ、どんなに時間がかかっても……<CR>会いたい人に、会える世界がいいです
records.en_original: Even if it takes forever, I want a world where I can see the ones I long to meet.
records.en: Even if it takes forever, I want a world<CR>where I can see the ones I long to meet.

records.jp: 詩帆たちが、土台を作ってくれたんだね
records.en_original: Shiho and the others laid the foundation for this, didn't they?
records.en: Shiho and the others laid the foundation for this, didn't they?

records.jp: さぁ、私たちも
records.en_original: All right, let's go too.
records.en: All right, let's go too.

records.jp: うん
records.en_original: Yeah.
records.en: Yeah.

records.jp: そうだね
records.en_original: You're right.
records.en: You're right.

records.jp: 私は、次の世界でも絶対二人のことを忘れない
records.en_original: I'll never forget you two, no matter what world we're in.
records.en: I'll never forget you two, no matter what world we're in.

records.jp: ふふ、実績があるもんね
records.en_original: Hehe, you already proved that, didn't you.
records.en: Hehe, you already proved that, didn't you.

records.jp: ライムたちもヒナちゃんのこと、忘れない
records.en_original: We won't forget you either, Hina.
records.en: We won't forget Hina-chan either.

records.jp: ずっと、繋がってるから。ここで
records.en_original: We'll always be connected. Right here.
records.en: We'll always be connected. Right here.
